summary: Stem games for kids to learn anatomy & biology. Explore organs, systems & bones
description:
How Does the Human Body Work? is a fun and educational app for kids aged 4 and up. Explore the human body through interactive games and discover how organs, muscles, bones and systems work — all while learning healthy habits and basic biology concepts.

🎮 Learn through play

Watch the heart pump blood, help your character breathe, digest food, and even pee! Take care of your character by feeding them, trimming their nails, or helping them cool down when they’re hot. You can even take care of a pregnant woman and see how a baby grows inside her belly!

🧠 Explore 9 interactive scenes that bring anatomy to life:

Circulatory System
Zoom into the heart and watch blood cells in action — red, white and platelets — keeping the body healthy.
Respiratory System
Help your character breathe in and out, and explore lungs, bronchi and alveoli while adjusting breathing rhythms.
Urogenital System
Learn how the kidneys filter the blood and how the bladder works. Help your character go to the toilet!
Digestive System
Feed your character and follow the food's journey through the body — from digestion to waste.
Nervous System
Discover the brain and how senses like sight, smell and hearing work through the body's nerves.
Skeletal System
Explore the bones that help us move, walk, jump and run. Learn bone names and how they help produce blood.
Muscular System
See how muscles contract and relax to move and protect the body. Rotate your character to see muscles on both sides!
Skin
Discover how skin protects us and reacts to temperature. Wipe away sweat, cut nails, and even paint them!
Pregnancy
Take care of a pregnant woman, take her blood pressure, do an ultrasound and see how a baby develops.
🍎 Healthy habits through biology

Understand why exercise is important, how smoke affects the lungs, and why a balanced diet helps the body grow strong and healthy. We only have one body — let’s take care of it!

📚 STEM learning made fun

Perfect for early learners and curious kids, this app introduces STEM concepts through hands-on discovery. Explore biology and anatomy with engaging activities and no stress or pressure.
